In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mRNA expression of the angiotension and endothelin systems is not uniform throughout follicular growth and is compartment specific.
the expression of the angiotension and endothelin systems is not only tissue-specific but also stage-specific in follicular development.
the angiotensinin-2 and endothelin-2 systems play important roles in folliculogenesis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mRNA expression for the members of both angiotensin- and endothelin systems is regulated in follicles during their final growth.
follicular growth is accompanied by the up- and down-regulation of the mRNA expression for the members of angiotensin (ACE, AT1R, and AT2R) and endothelin system (ECE, ET-1, ETR-A, and ETR-B).
the expression of ACE, AT1R, and ECE in TI and AT2R, AT2R, and ETR-A in GC is consistent throughout follicle growth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mRNA expression of members of both the angiotensinin and endothelin systems is regulated in a tissue-specific manner and is dependent on the follicular maturation stage.
the angiotensine system is more important than the endothelin system for the regulation of follicular maturation.
the mRNA expression of members of the angiongensin and endothelin system in bovine follicles is regulated by follicle size and estradiol content of follicular fluids.
